ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there are two probability distribution tables. The title of the left table is X, listing x=0,1,2,3, with corresponding probabilities respectively 0.4, 0.3, 0.2, 0.1. The title of the right table is Y, listing y=1,2,3,4, with corresponding probabilities respectively 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4. Then reason: The problem gives that X and Y are independent, and Z=X+Y. It asks for P(Z≤2), that is, enumerate all combinations satisfying X+Y≤2. Because the minimum of Y is 1, the combinations satisfying the condition are (X,Y)=(0,1),(0,2),(1,1). Independence makes the joint probability equal to the product of marginal probabilities, so the total probability is 0.4×0.1 + 0.4×0.2 + 0.3×0.1 = 0.04 + 0.08 + 0.03 = 0.15.

raw_record.question_text: X and Y are independent random variables; the probability distributions for each are given in the table above. Let Z = X + Y. What is P(Z ≤ 2)?

method.method_draft: First read the image: the left table gives X with probabilities P(X=0)=0.4, P(X=1)=0.3, P(X=2)=0.2, P(X=3)=0.1; the right table gives Y values 1,2,3,4 with probabilities 0.1,0.2,0.3,0.4 respectively. From the text, use Z=X+Y and the independence of X and Y. Enumerate all value pairs whose sum is at most 2: (X,Y)=(0,1),(0,2),(1,1). Multiply marginal probabilities for each pair and add: 0.4·0.1 + 0.4·0.2 + 0.3·0.1 = 0.15.

method.method_draft: First read the image: X has probabilities 0.4,0.3,0.2,0.1 at x=0,1,2,3, and Y has probabilities 0.1,0.2,0.3,0.4 at y=1,2,3,4. From the text, Z=X+Y, so condition on the possible values of X and compute P(Y≤2−X). For X=0, need Y≤2, whose probability from the Y table is 0.1+0.2=0.3. For X=1, need Y≤1, probability 0.1. For X=2 or 3, need Y≤0 or Y≤−1, impossible from the Y table. Thus P(Z≤2)=P(X=0)P(Y≤2)+P(X=1)P(Y≤1)=0.4·0.3+0.3·0.1=0.15.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中有两个概率分布表。左表标题为 X，列出 x=0,1,2,3 时的概率分别为 0.4, 0.3, 0.2, 0.1。右表标题为 Y，列出 y=1,2,3,4 时的概率分别为 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4。推理：题目给出 X 与 Y 独立，且 Z=X+Y。要求 P(Z≤2)，即按 X 的可能取值计算 P(Y≤2−X)。当 X=0 时，需要 Y≤2，概率为 0.1+0.2=0.3，贡献为 0.4×0.3=0.12。当 X=1 时，需要 Y≤1，概率为 0.1，贡献为 0.3×0.1=0.03。当 X=2 或 3 时，需要 Y≤0 或 Y≤−1，不可能，贡献为 0。因此 P(Z≤2)=0.12+0.03=0.15。
